title: [UI][Sorting] Price low to high sorts numerically
precondition: Standard user is logged in and is on the Products page showing the default order.

steps.action: Read the prices from top to bottom
Compare the positions of Sauce Labs Onesie ($7.99) and the two $15.99 products
steps.expected: Sauce Labs Onesie is listed before Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt and Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red)

steps.action: Compare the position of Sauce Labs Bike Light ($9.99) with the two $15.99 products
steps.expected: Sauce Labs Bike Light is listed before both $15.99 products (a text-based sort would place "$15.99" first)

gherkin:
Given I am on the Products page
When I select "Price (low to high)"
Then prices read $7.99, $9.99, $15.99, $15.99, $29.99, $49.99
And $9.99 comes before $15.99
